subject: Uplift signal + QBR slot lock for Vaultis renewal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultis.io>; Priya Shah <priya@vaultis.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Uplift signal + QBR slot lock for Vaultis renewal

Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the chat last week. Vaultis' usage pattern and the trial analytics we ran show a clear uplift signal into next quarter; looks like the team will need the extra throughput and a modest term shift to get predictable unit economics.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–40m):
- Quick context: usage delta and forecast through FY28
- Proposed term changes and pricing impact (three options)
- Capacity plan + timing for burst vs. steady-state
- QBR: draft agenda and stakeholder invites
- Next steps and owners (legal/security/ops)

Can you confirm a 30–40m slot next week? Open times from our side:
- Tue 20 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 21 Jul, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 22 Jul, 09:00–09:45 PT

I'll attach a short draft mutual action plan and the SLA amendment we typically use as a starting point.

If that works, we'll lock a QBR block and circulate the initial MAP for comment.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Draft_MAP_Vaultis_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SLA_Amendment_Vaultis_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultis.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@vaultis.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 07:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Uplift signal + QBR slot lock for Vaultis renewal

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. Wed 21 Jul, 14:00 PT works for us; please go ahead and lock it. Priya will join from the product org and I’ll bring our lead infra engineer for the capacity discussion.

A couple of asks so we come prepared:
- We'd like to see a brief run-rate forecast (tokens/day) mapped to each pricing option.
- Any notes on expected latency/SLA changes with the proposed capacity tiers.
- Highlight what would require a legal amendment vs. a PO addendum.

Look forward to the kickoff.

—Liam
Head of Platform | Vaultis
liam@vaultis.io

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Uplift signal + QBR slot lock for Vaultis renewal

Locked: Wed 21 Jul, 14:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Quick internal owners list before the kickoff (short bullets so we can be crisp):
- Pre-read + run-rate mapping (tokens/day / month): Ben Carter (sales ops) — due EOD Tue 20 Jul — see attachment Draft_MAP_Vaultis_v1.xlsx
- Legal scope + what requires amendment: Monica Patel (legal) — bring the standard redlines and quick notes
- SLA/latency notes + ops feasibility: Karthik & Infrastructure team (we'll pull in infra SME to the meeting)
- QBR agenda + invite list: Marissa Cole (CS lead) — I’ll draft and share a 1-pager before the call

I’ve attached the MAP draft and a first-pass SLA amendment. Ben, please populate the run-rate options and add the cost delta columns — keep it to three pricing paths (Conservative / Aggressive / Staircase). Monica, flag anything that looks like a legal blocker for a simple PO vs. amendment flow.

Thanks — would like a final pre-read in my inbox by 12:00 PT on Wed so we can go tight in the call.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultis.io>, Priya Shah <priya@vaultis.io>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Uplift signal + QBR slot lock for Vaultis renewal

All —

Updated MAP attached (finalized run-rate table + three pricing paths). Summary notes below for the meeting deck:
- Conservative: 20% uplift, 12-month term, modest price concession (est. +$6k/month)
- Aggressive: 60% uplift, 24-month term with staircase pricing, larger initial commit (est. +$18k/month)
- Staircase: step-ups over three quarters with built-in scale triggers; best long-term unit economics

I flagged which cells will require legal amendment (term > 12 months, SLA addendum) and which can go through PO addendum.

Marissa — pre-read attached; I also added a one-slide QBR agenda under tab 'QBR' so we can share with Vaultis at the top of the call.

See you on Wed.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
